jobs.title: Front-end Engineer
jobs.description: As a member of the Purchase Flow Client Core team, I work on one of the company’s flagship products, its online payment solution. It’s a service used by more than 100 million people and features custom integrations with some of the biggest tech companies, including Apple, Google, Airbnb and TikTok. I’ve contributed to major rewrites of the system as well as new product releases, such as the Klarna Card.

jobs.title: UI Engineer
jobs.description: I was in the Logs team at LogicMonitor, which became a part of the company after a Swedish startup was acquired. I joined shortly after the acquisition so I was able to develop and grow the product from early on. One of the things I worked on was building a new micro frontend for the logs page. The Stockholm office was closed down in 2023.

jobs.title: Front-end developer
jobs.description: Origo is one of the biggest tech companies in Iceland. In my time there I worked in two departments, Travel Solutions and Healthcare Solutions. I worked on a variety of projects, including the biggest car rental system in the country and Heilsuvera, the national health portal. I was also part of a small team that built a system to keep track of all COVID-19 samplings and vaccinations in the country.
